name: auto-pull
description: Automatically keeps the checked-out branch up to date with its upstream by running a guarded fetch and fast-forward pull when a workspace opens and on a configurable interval.

autoPull.enabled.description: Run the guarded auto pull cycle when a workspace opens and on the configured interval.

autoPull.intervalSeconds.description: Interval in seconds between auto pull cycles. The first cycle runs when the workspace opens.

autoPull.strategy.description: How integration is performed when the checked-out branch is behind its upstream. "ff-only" fast-forwards and never creates merge commits. "rebase" rebases local commits onto the upstream. Divergent branches are never merged automatically.

autoPull.includeUntrackedFiles.description: Treat untracked files as non-blocking for the clean-tree guard. Tracked modifications, staged changes, in-progress merges, rebases, and cherry-picks always block the cycle.

autoPull.showStatusBarItem.description: Show the last auto pull cycle result in the status bar.

autoPull.logLevel.description: Verbosity of the Auto Pull output channel.

scripts.package: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run coverage && pnpm run bundle:prod && node ./scripts/package-vsix.cjs
